rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for a person seeking election or appointment.

example.english: Each candidate has their own election platform.
example.traditional: 每個候選人都有自己嘅政綱。
example.jyutping: mui5 go3 hau6 syun2 jan4 dou1 jau5 zi6 gei2 ge3 zing3 gong1

rows.note: Use this specifically for someone taking an examination.

example.english: Every candidate in this group has to take the English exam tomorrow.
example.traditional: 呢批考生聽日要考英文。
example.jyutping: ni1 pai1 haau2 saang1 ting1 jat6 jiu3 haau2 jing1 man4

rows.note: Use this for a person regarded as a likely or suitable choice for a position.

example.english: Ming is a good candidate for this job.
example.traditional: 阿明係呢份工嘅好人選。
example.jyutping: aa3 ming4 hai6 ni1 fan6 gung1 ge3 hou2 jan4 syun2

rows.note: Use this formal noun for a person or thing being considered or judged suitable for a purpose.

example.english: This project is a candidate for this year's best design award.
example.traditional: 呢份計劃係今屆最佳設計獎嘅候選者之一。
example.jyutping: ni1 fan6 gai3 waak6 hai6 gam1 gaai3 zeoi3 gaai1 cit3 gai3 zoeng2 ge3 hau6 syun2 ze2 zi1 jat1
